canonical_title: Special condition for rear lift truss

amendments.text: truss. When a rear lift truss is employed, it shall be designed for conditions of reversed airflow at a design speed of: V=10/W/S+10 (m. p. h.) Note: It may be assumed that the value of C, is equal to —0.8 and the chordwise distributior is triangular between a peak at the trailing edge and zero at the leading edge.
